variantPolicy: Extension-only: compact ON, height/palette/shape/spatial/traversal OFF; density equals lighting; normal and far surface are independent alternatives. Allowed presets: baseline, reference-performance, performance, normal-cache, surface-hybrid.
notes: FHD window, VSync disabled by runtime harness, FrameTiming enabled. Build does not auto-connect a Profiler. Dedicated CLI benchmark binary; use -cloudBenchmark with the allowed presets and -cloudQuit. Startup uses performance settings; other runtime panel combinations are not supported.
